title: Upload links: a link is issued for a record the user cannot change, and the upload page then says "Done. The file was attached" when nothing was attached (readonlyWhen), or "Upload failed" with no reason (approval lock, 500)
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible false success).
reach: public entries `/api/v1/mcp` `create_upload_link` + the upload-link page in a browser, measured once each on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`, Team plan; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`), member's own MCP OAuth token and browser session.

## Business reason

An employee asks the agent to add an invoice to their expense claim. The agent hands them a link, they upload, the page says it worked, and the claim has no new invoice. Nobody finds out until finance asks where the invoice is.

## Setup

Object `ebqu_claim` with `invoices: { type: 'file', multiple: true, readonlyWhen: "record.status == 'pending' || record.status == 'approved'" }` and an approval flow on `status = pending` (record lock while pending).

## What happens

| Record state | `create_upload_link { field: 'invoices' }` | Upload page after Send | Record |
|---|---|---|---|
| draft | link | "Done. The file was attached" | file appended ✅ |
| pending (approval lock) | **link issued** | **"Upload failed"** — `PUT /api/v1/storage/upload-links/…` → **500**; log: `[5xx] 500 — RECORD_LOCKED: 报销单 '…' is locked while an approval is in progress` | unchanged |
| approved (`readonlyWhen` true) | **link issued** | **"Done. The file was attached; you can close this page."** | **unchanged** — log `WARN Field 'invoices' is read-only (readonlyWhen) — ignoring incoming change` |

For comparison, `update_record` on the same approved record answers `droppedFields: [{ fields: ['amount'], reason: 'readonly_when' }]`, so the agent is told; the upload page tells the person nothing.

## Expected

- `create_upload_link` refuses when the field is not writable for this user on this record now (locked or `readonly`/`readonlyWhen`), with the reason, so the agent does not hand out a dead link.
- If state changes after the link was issued, the page shows a refusal with the reason (`RECORD_LOCKED` as a 4xx, a read-only field as a refusal) and does not keep the uploaded `sys_file`.
- The page never says "attached" when the field did not take the file.

Reader who acts: the storage seat (`service-storage` upload-link door, `record-file-access.ts` field commit) and the `packages/mcp` seat (`create_upload_link`).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue upload link readonly attached` → 24 hits (#30892, #26479, #25572 closed — none on this); `upload link RECORD_LOCKED` → 7 hits, QA runs only; `"Upload failed" upload link` → 19 hits (#24548 closed, a different commit bug). The page's English-only copy is objectstack#32684.
